messages:
Maya: quick check-in from roadmap sync 1: we need a concrete cutover acceptance and IP reservation flow for private deployments. Customers keep asking for a machine-readable manifest they can use in change-control. Proposal: manifest + signed token + preflight hook. Thoughts?

Rachel: love the manifest idea. Suggest two manifest flavors: reservation (static IPs for X window) and prediction (tenant-nat best-effort with confidence score). Reservation should include valid_from/valid_until and an audit_token.

Tom: implementational notes: exporter CLI will generate manifest.json and a detached signature. Example:
```bash
./redwood export-manifest --profile=vpc-reserved --window=24h --out=manifest.json --sign-with=cmk://acme/key1
```
The signer attaches audit_token that references KMS envelope. We'll also emit a manifest-check command to verify server-side before cutover.

netops-bot: ci pipeline scheduled: job=7753 profile=vpc-reserved preflight=manifest-verify :gear:

Rachel: preflight hook should do: 1) verify signature, 2) assert IP availability (if customer provided IPAM API), 3) run curl smoke test through declared egress IPs. If any fail, abort with clear revert steps.

security: important - manifests/exports MUST be envelope-encrypted with customer CMK OR signed with customer key. Also require immutable audit event: who generated, request_id, and TTL. Add retention policy: 90d for audit logs, 30d for manifest artifacts unless customer opts out.

Tom: cutover acceptance criteria (candidate): - manifest verified and consumed by customer firewall; - rolling canary (5% -> 25% -> 100%) passes health checks; - no more than 1-minute egress IP drift per service; - auto-revert trigger works and completes within configured window.

Maya: prioritization: Phase 1: vpc-reserved manifest + signer + preflight (target 4w). Phase 2: relay-egress deterministic canaries + opt-in reservation API (6-8w). Phase 3: tenant-nat prediction + IPAM integration (Q3). Passive-agentless upgrades deferred.

ci-bot: nightly run queued: job=7761 test=manifest-verify profile=vpc-reserved :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Rachel: action items: - spec manifest schema + examples (owner: rachel) - exporter CLI prototype + signer integration (owner: tom) - preflight CI tests + manifest-verify (owner: ci-team) - KMS binding + audit retention (owner: security).

Maya: booking 30m follow-up with eng/netops/security tomorrow. @tom @rachel bring sample manifests and one failing edge-case. Closing thread.
